P.name: Assassin's Mark
P.title: Template:Data Akali/Assassin's Mark
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Assassin's Mark|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Akali
|skill        = I
|icon         = Assassin's Mark.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Akali''' damages an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an {{tip|ability}}, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions. For 2 seconds, she gains {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 to 60 for 4|1 to 16}} {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving away from the center of the ring. Only one ring may be active at a time.
|description2 = When '''Akali''' exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with ''Swinging Kama'' for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
|description3 = {{sbc|Swinging Kama:}} '''Akali's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|{{tt|'''doubled''' range|Not necessarily increased by 125, check notes}}}} and deal {{pplevel|35 to 53 for 7; then + 9*x for 6; then + 15*x|formula=+3 per level until lvl 7; then +9 until lvl 13, then +15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|effect radius= {{tt|500|Ring radius}}
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spell
|parry        = true
|spellshield  = false
|notes        = 
* Enemies cannot see the ring, but can see the empower effect.
* ''Swinging Kama'' gives a static '''bonus''' range which doesn't change if '''Akali's''' range changes during it (i.e {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}):
** If ''Rapid Firecannon'' fully charges within ''Swinging Kama's'' duration, '''Akali's''' total range increases to {{tt|337.5|(125 + 125 (which is the bonus range Swinging Kama gives)){{times}}1.35}}.
** If ''Rapid Firecannon'' fully charges before gaining ''Swinging Kama'', '''Akali's''' total range is increased to {{tt|395|125{{times}}1.35 + 125{{times}}1.35 (which is the bonus range Swinging Kama gives){{times}}1.35 (further increased by Rapid Firecannon)}}.
* The ring will be created around the last target hit by ''{{ai|Five Point Strike|Akali}}''.
* The ring's center is offset 120 units away from the enemy's center, towards Akali.
* The empowered attack can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, and will be mitigated by {{tip|blind|blinds}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the time of its application.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Akali}} damaging {{tip|abilities}} against a champion create a ring around them for a few seconds, and she gains {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} while moving away from the ring.
|blurb2       = Once '''Akali''' exits the ring, she regains the {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} towards enemy champions and empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} with {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and {{as|magic damage}}.
}}
